title: Ricci Microstructure v1 — Dataset Contract
description: Preregistered dataset contract for the ricci_microstructure_v1 research line. A real, promotable dataset is an immutable, sha256-pinned crypto-perp depth-5 order book of sufficient depth. A zero/placeholder data_sha256 or is_synthetic=true is treated as non-evidence. Unknown fields fail validation.

data_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the immutable session. The all-zero digest marks a placeholder (no real data).

min_data_depth_sec.description: Observed contiguous depth in seconds; promotion requires >= 3600.

is_synthetic.description: True for pipeline-instrumentation data; synthetic data can never promote the claim tier.
